title: an action call through a collaborator on an unfinished receiver fails before its arguments
purpose: The construct is invalid and must not complete.

failure.justification: The collaborator receives the receiver as an ordinary parameter, so only execution can see that its construction is pending.

provenance.origin: authored for #271 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.4: the restriction follows receiver identity through collaborators; runtime rejects every action dispatch on a receiver whose construction is pending, before evaluating its arguments. The argument's write must not happen.
